question: After the CAS defects are fixed, should grouped updates include package installation even though later failures may retain installed artifacts and return update_partial?
rationale: The installer has no artifact rollback, so accepting retained package state and its recovery workflow is a product and operator-contract decision.

options.title: Accept diagnosable partial installs
options.body: Keep package updates only with clear status/doctor recovery, focused partial-state proof, and explicit documentation of retained artifacts.

options.title: Defer package updates
options.body: Keep package actions blocked until an ownership-safe uninstall or transactional artifact rollback contract exists.

recommendation.title: Accept diagnosable partial installs
recommendation.body: Keep package updates only with clear status/doctor recovery, focused partial-state proof, and explicit documentation of retained artifacts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent config architecture ownership and repository-level product work make this the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
